The prompt's paste sanitizer strips leaked bracketed-paste markers with two regexes: one for the opening `[200~` and one for the closing `[201~`. The opening regex required a boundary character (space, newline, `:`, `)`, etc.) immediately before it. The closing regex only checked what came after it, and end-of-string counts as a boundary.
